test_title: PYST 207: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 30th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following diagram, the 'circle' stands for 'soldiers', the 'square' stands for 'Indians', and the 'triangle' stands for 'singers'. The numbers given in the different segments represent persons belonging to that category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54a64fc1f3a256a909ea8821f8bf66b88be0218f10002069d661ff86205b09fe.png] 

Which category is represented by the number '5'?

options.text: Indian singers who are not soldiers
Indian soldiers who are not singers
Indians who are neither singers nor soldiers

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a224c9105fd04507ecbeffa1cb62221f45a5572b3c1372b1276b125514db6365.png] 

∴ Here, Number 5 part is represented as "Indian singers who are not soldiers".

Hence, the correct answer is **"Indian singers who are not soldiers".**
